acceptanceCriteria: test-validity --discover on a JS/TS fixture with a serial-isolated test reports ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL (test)
CLI and MCP outputs are byte-identical
body: Residual from V1-1798 (PR #1150). RSpec source findings flow into `test-validity --discover`, but JS/TS discovery attaches none, so ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL is visible only through `corvint tests validity --files`. Expected: --discover carries the same source findings for JS/TS tests as for RSpec.
title: test-validity --discover attaches no source findings for JS/TS tests (ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL appears only in tests validity)
